tools.name: list_games
tools.description:
Lists every PlaySnack game with its game_id, title, player range, length and page link — for browsing, or for finding a game_id by name. together_only: true keeps only the games played together, each on their own phone.
PlaySnack 게임 전체 목록(game_id·이름·인원·시간).

tools.name: get_game
tools.description:
Returns one game's rules in a few sentences (how a round goes), its player range, length and what it suits. game_id comes from list_games or recommend_games.
게임 한 개의 규칙·인원·시간.
